# Edge_Intelligence

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capability of a network edge device to perform learning and inference locally, using distributed neuromorphic units rather than centralized servers. Shifts computation into the network fabric, a core goal of iNEST for low-latency, privacy-preserving AI at the periphery.
